title: Safe Update Routine
description: Structured process for applying WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates with rollback plan.

steps.title: Take Pre-Update Backup
steps.instructions: Create a fresh full backup immediately before updates. Note backup ID or snapshot name for quick rollback.

steps.title: Read Update Changelogs
steps.instructions: Review release notes for breaking changes, PHP version requirements, and known conflicts with the active theme/builder.

steps.title: Update Staging First
steps.instructions: Apply updates on staging in order: plugins → theme → core (or follow your agency's preferred order).

steps.title: Smoke Test Critical Paths
steps.instructions: Test homepage, main navigation, contact form, login, checkout (if WooCommerce), and one admin task flow.

steps.title: Deploy to Production
steps.instructions: Apply the same update sequence on production during the agreed maintenance window. Enable maintenance mode if needed.

steps.title: Purge All Caches
steps.instructions: Clear page cache, CDN cache, and opcode cache after production updates. Verify CSS/JS load without stale bundles.

steps.title: Monitor for 24 Hours
steps.instructions: Watch error logs, uptime alerts, and form submissions for 24 hours after production updates. Roll back if regressions appear.
